notes.title: Collect all the critters and more at Creature Collector Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Fans of creature collecting games unite![/h1]

If you find yourself with the undeniable urge to rescue and collect every cute lil’ critter you come across in a video game, then the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/creature_collector]Creature Collector Fest[/url] is for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/a9e1a054baa2821e0b158ba5a952f291272d1928.png[/img]

Alongside a host of other adorable titles, you’ll find our own cosy offering - Critter Café. 

Escape to a new life in Gold Leaf Isle where, through a series of mysterious letters, you’ll find yourself tasked with rescuing adorable, fantasy critters in need of your help. Design and run your own café, care for your critters, uncover the secrets of mysterious portals, and create a wholesome café for all to enjoy!

[b]The event runs 12 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET to 19 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET.[/b]

And if you find yourself needing even more critters for your collection, the [b]Little Critters Festival[[/b] is also taking place from 13 May - 20 May, which we'll be featuring in. Keep an eye out for that one on Steam.

Happy creature collecting!

notes.title: Critter Café Update 1 - Full Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi friends! The first post-launch update for Critter Café, available on both Steam and Nintendo Switch, addresses a number of player-requested changes and introduces more quality of life improvements.  

We hope you enjoy the new update! The Critter Café team will continue to gather community feedback and keep you informed on any further planned changes.  

[list]
[*] Sprint Toggle option added. This allows players to enable an option for players to Sprint with a single button press, instead of having to hold a button down 
[*] Toggle options added for pushing/pulling blocks during puzzles, and for the coffee pouring minigame in Open for Trade  
[*] During Open for Trade, Critters will no longer block or impede the player when they are moving across the café  
[*] Selected portal puzzles will include additional guidance to help players complete them, following community feedback 
[*] In the Tutorials section of the Journal, further guidance for Bookings has been added to assist players on how to select the correct items 
[*] Updated the descriptions for the ‘Best of Friends’ and We’re All Best Friends Here’ achievements to clarify how to complete them. Players must interact with all Critters who have reached Max Bond and trigger the ‘best friends’ cutscene for these achievements to unlock  
[*] Roaming behaviour of Critters during Open for Trade has been adjusted, meaning Critters can seem livelier around customers  
[*] Added more settings to adjust the speed of the camera and floor cursor in Customisation Mode 
[*] Steam Deck: Fixes and improvements to controller behaviour when using an external controller 
[*] Steam Deck: Fixed issue causing only three columns to appear in the Critterpedia section 
[*] Fixed instances of Critters incorrectly floating after the ‘Max Bond’ animation is skipped 
[*] Multiple fixes and improvements to localisation and localised text on screen
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update! The Critter Café team will continue to gather community feedback and keep you informed on any further planned changes.  

We'd love to welcome you into our cosy community over on  [url=https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC]Discord[/url]. You'll find announcements, surprises, and general cosy vibes on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://x.com/crittercafegame]X[/url].

notes.title: Critter Café Mailbox - Game Team Update: January 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/2106e686e1063a0256692504dc954865856ce729.png[/img]

Hey there everyone 😊 Following the launch of Critter Café at the end of last year, the game team wanted to share a short article with you on our first post-launch update.  

Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone for your support so far on Critter Café. It’s still incredible to see something that began life as a game jam prototype now available to the world, and enjoyed by many people. We’ve loved seeing your stories, journeys, and thoughts on the game, and look forward to seeing more! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/1afcb625fbb3b478fbb79b6c930ce60d6a6f59d5.png[/img]


We’re pleased to confirm that an update for Critter Café is planned to be released, simultaneously on Steam and Nintendo Switch, early this year. This update will focus on adding a handful of changes and options that our players have requested, either to improve the overall experience, or to further assist with accessibility. There will also be technical fixes to improve performance on all platforms and devices.  

Further assistance and guidance will be added in some areas of the game, including with Bookings, how to complete certain challenges, and with selected puzzles that our community highlighted as particularly difficult. Critter behaviour in the café during ‘Open for Trade’ shifts is also an area we plan to address, aiming to make them more lively around customers, whilst ensuring they no longer impede the player’s movement around the café. 

Also, we’re looking at adding toggle options for multiple actions that currently require the player to hold down a button or key, as well as more player choice for camera and cursor speed when customising spaces.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/5ad2b91f188c0b2a6d6010ad706ba5ec90c8af32.png[/img]


Work on this update is ongoing right now, and it’ll take a little time to finalise the changes and go through the required processes for updating on both Steam and Switch. Once everything is ready, we’ll share a confirmed release date, along with full patch notes.  

Please feel free to share questions and thoughts either here on Steam, or over on the [url=https://discord.gg/2kgsDDE5dU]Secret Mode Discord server[/url], where a dedicated Critter Café channel lives. Again, a huge thank you for your support. We’re excited to share more details soon!

notes.title: Mini Games in Critter Café - Opening and Serving in Your Café
notes.content:
When Critter Café opens its doors on November 26 for Steam and Nintendo Switch, your very own café will be at the centre of a cosy, magical journey. But what good is running a café if it’s never open? Plus, how can you make sure you're serving the best possible eats and treats to your customers? In this post, let's take a closer look at how to run your café, so it operates as nicely as it looks!

When you decide the time is right for your café to be open for business, head over to the register at the back right of the café. Select the Critters who’ll accompany you on your shift, and get ready for some eager customers to arrive. Once you're Open for Business, you'll have a set amount of time to fulfil orders from folks in your café. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/11942951b91c25754377d3c76062788c75902ecb.png[/img]

Customers will raise their hands for attention, and it’s your job to take their order and fulfill their wishes with the following mini games:


[h2]Pouring coffee! [/h2]

Fill the cup of coffee up to the line for that perfect cup of joe.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f4a32da769660aa59fed2149203f7e6da7ecd686.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/a7d3df69953f605dfd6d33647cc6349a3d6637f9.png[/img]

 
[h2]Deliver treats! [/h2]

Remember the customer’s request and bring them food in the correct sequence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f232ec08ed8660012d5dfc8a3e4adfb0e514a366.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/002415aed44f37218c69540a921bfc2e3113e099.png[/img]


[h2]Latte art! [/h2]

Match the button presses to finish drinks with an artistic flourish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/d3895c56121f9e50bf91b40deb09e223ccfada10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/fd7623af6ab5c98f97e771dc427ec76bd8048841.png[/img]


[h2]Cake slicing! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/11942951b91c25754377d3c76062788c75902ecb.png[/img]

Cut slices of cake to match the requested portion size. Make mine a large one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/de25d53773cbb60898e558c0d4667606da6023e8.png[/img]


Every shift is ranked out of three stars. Master these mini games and you’ll delight your customers. But don’t worry if you don't get things exactly right: while your final rank determines how much EXP you earn, there’s no punishment for getting any orders wrong, and customers will be eager to come again the next time you open your doors. 

Join our cosy community on Discord, and follow Critter Café on TikTok, Instagram and X, as we head towards the grand opening of Critter Café on November 26!

notes.title: Critter Café Demo - What to Expect From October 14
notes.content:
Hey there everyone, 

The entire Critter Café team is so excited to be a part of Steam Next Fest, and to be rolling out a demo for our game, available from October 14!  

This is your first chance to get an early taste of our cosy fantastical world, launching for Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 26. Whilst running and renovating your own café and serving treats to your guests, rescue Critters from mysterious puzzle-filled portals, and build bonds with your Critters to help make your café extra special.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/97d307aee75056677e21c902f07c4411890f7341.jpg[/img]


[h2]WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT IN THE CRITTER CAFÉ DEMO? [/h2]

The demo will include the first slice of the Critter Café experience, starting from the very beginning of the game. You’ll be able to play through the first handful of ‘days’ in the game, introducing you to key features and characters.  

You’ll have a chance to run your café for the first time, serving customers and fulfilling their orders via fun minigames. Also, you’ll be able to customise the look and layout of your café – from the furniture, to the wallpaper, to Critter toys  – with an early set of unlocked items.  

Away from the café, you will have the chance to find and rescue your first two Critters. Rescuing them will require solving puzzles, which sometimes require tools to solve. You’ll get the first of those items during the demo. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/ee7c90e5b077d8cffb3998a4ee2de054d56256dd.jpg[/img]

Once rescued, you’ll have the chance to build a bond with your Critters, discover potential traits that influence their behaviour, and even have them in your café, setting up bookings for guests to meet them. There are more features and mysteries in the demo, but we’ll leave those for you to discover! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/92ed2e5d438198a87eabf6534a13687ee285d3cc.jpg[/img]


[h2]JOIN THE CRITTER CAFÉ CLUB [/h2]

Please keep in mind that the demo is a work-in-progress snippet of the game, meaning some aspects may be incomplete, or you may bump into an issue or two. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367610/Critter_Caf/]Chat with our team on Discord[/url], or in the Steam Community area, if you experience anything you’d like to report, as we continue finalising the full game for launch on November 26. 

We’d really appreciate if you could [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367610/Critter_Caf/]Wishlist Critter Café[/url]. Doing so will also make sure you’re notified when the Steam Demo is available! Thank you, and please enjoy the Critter Café demo during Next Fest. Our team can’t wait for you to play 😊
